content.title: Cincinnati Reds announce 2026 Opening Day roster
content.text: The Cincinnati Reds have unveiled the 26 players who will open the 2026 season on the Opening Day roster.Cincinnati will open the year carrying 13 pitchers and 13 position players.Prior to the Opening Day roster being announced, the Reds placed Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list, due to a blister on his left index finger. Lefty Caleb Ferguson was also placed on the 15-day IL.In a corresponding move to Lodolo's injury, the Reds have called up Jose Franco, Cincinnati's No. 12 prospect according to MLB Pipeline. Across Double-A and Triple-A last year, Franco went 10-4 in 26 starts with a 3.11 ERA, strikig out 118 batters to walking just 54.No. 4 prospect Rhett Loweder, who made just five rehab starts in the minors last season, is also on this year's opening day roster.Another major name not on this year's Opening Day roster is another starting pitcher, Hunter Greene. After missing time last season due to a groin injury, the Reds' ace underwent elbow surgery earlier this month after being diagnosed with bone chips and loose bodies in his right elbow.Andrew Abbott will toe the rubber for the Reds on Opening Day, making his first career Opening Day start.The Reds open the season Thursday against the Boston Red Sox at 4:10 p.m. CINCINNATI —The Cincinnati Reds have unveiled the 26 players who will open the 2026 season on the Opening Day roster.Cincinnati will open the year carrying 13 pitchers and 13 position players. This content is imported from Twitter. You may be able to find the same content in another format, or you may be able to find more information, at their web site. Prior to the Opening Day roster being announced, the Reds placed Nick Lodolo on the 15-day injured list, due to a blister on his left index finger. Lefty Caleb Ferguson was also placed on the 15-day IL.In a corresponding move to Lodolo's injury, the Reds have called up Jose Franco, Cincinnati's No. 12 prospect according to MLB Pipeline. Across Double-A and Triple-A last year, Franco went 10-4 in 26 starts with a 3.11 ERA, strikig out 118 batters to walking just 54.No. 4 prospect Rhett Loweder, who made just five rehab starts in the minors last season, is also on this year's opening day roster. Another major name not on this year's Opening Day roster is another starting pitcher, Hunter Greene. After missing time last season due to a groin injury, the Reds' ace underwent elbow surgery earlier this month after being diagnosed with bone chips and loose bodies in his right elbow. Andrew Abbott will toe the rubber for the Reds on Opening Day, making his first career Opening Day start.The Reds open the season Thursday against the Boston Red Sox at 4:10 p.m.
